paragraphs.text: Researchers at a food laboratory in Lyon compared three common ways of storing sliced white bread at home. In each case they measured how long the bread stayed soft and how long it took for mould to appear.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Bread kept in a paper bag at room temperature dried out fastest, becoming hard after only two days. However, because the paper let moisture escape, mould did not appear until the sixth day.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: A sealed plastic bag kept the bread soft for four days, but it also trapped moisture, and mould was visible after just four days as well. The researchers suggest that this method is suitable only for bread that will be eaten quickly.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: The refrigerator produced the most surprising result. Although it slowed the growth of mould to around twelve days, the cold made the bread stale faster than any other method, a process caused by changes in the starch rather than by loss of water. The freezer, which the team tested separately, kept bread in good condition for three months.
paragraphs.label: D

items.quote: becoming hard after only two days
items.prompt: Paper bag: stays soft for 1 ____ days

explanation.en: “becoming hard after only two days” → 2 (or two). “Sixth day” is about mould — the next column.
explanation.kk: «becoming hard after only two days» → 2 (немесе two). «Sixth day» — зең, бұл келесі баған.
explanation.ru: «becoming hard after only two days» → 2 (или two). «Sixth day» — плесень, это следующая колонка.

items.quote: because the paper let moisture escape

explanation.en: “the paper let moisture escape” → moisture. “Lets … escape” in the table is the same structure as in the text.
explanation.kk: «the paper let moisture escape» → moisture. Кестедегі «lets … escape» — мәтіндегі құрылыммен бірдей.
explanation.ru: «the paper let moisture escape» → moisture. «Lets … escape» в таблице — та же конструкция, что в тексте.

items.quote: mould was visible after just four days as well
items.prompt: Plastic bag: mould appears after 3 ____ days

explanation.en: “mould was visible after just four days as well” → 4 (or four). Matching “soft for four days” is not a mistake: “as well” shows both periods are the same.
explanation.kk: «mould was visible after just four days as well» → 4 (немесе four). «soft for four days» дегенмен бірдей болуы қате емес: «as well» екі мерзім де бірдей екенін көрсетеді.
explanation.ru: «mould was visible after just four days as well» → 4 (или four). Совпадение с «soft for four days» не ошибка: «as well» показывает, что оба срока одинаковые.

items.quote: it slowed the growth of mould to around twelve days
items.prompt: Refrigerator: mould appears after about 4 ____ days

explanation.en: “slowed the growth of mould to around twelve days” → 12 (or twelve). “Three months” is the freezer, which is not in the table.
explanation.kk: «slowed the growth of mould to around twelve days» → 12 (немесе twelve). «Three months» — мұздатқыш, ол кестеде жоқ.
explanation.ru: «slowed the growth of mould to around twelve days» → 12 (или twelve). «Three months» — морозилка, её в таблице нет.

items.quote: the cold made the bread stale faster than any other method

explanation.en: “made the bread stale faster than any other method” → stale. “Hard” from paragraph B does not fit: that is the paper bag, and the text stresses the fridge effect is not about losing water.
explanation.kk: «made the bread stale faster than any other method» → stale. B абзацындағы «hard» келмейді: ол қағаз пакет туралы, ал тоңазытқышта мәселе судың азаюында емес екені айтылған.
explanation.ru: «made the bread stale faster than any other method» → stale. «Hard» из абзаца B не подходит: так бумажный пакет, и в тексте подчёркнуто, что в холодильнике дело не в потере воды.
